name: Request for Annual Appraisal Status
goal: User asks about the status of their annual appraisal in Hinglish.
constraints: Bot should provide current appraisal status and next steps.

phases.description: User says 'Mera annual appraisal ka kya status hai?'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot replies with current appraisal status and any pending actions.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
